_comment: One object per graphic. Every quote must be Mark's own words, with a source. Headlines are ALWAYS two words. Add new concepts by appending — do not edit approved ones in place.

headline: TAX
SHIFT
concepts.quote: We're not paying lower taxes. We're paying different taxes.
concepts.source: Shifting Tax Burden.mov @ 32.5s — Mark's own words
concepts.notes: Anchors the Aug 11 newsletter. Best line in the video library.

headline: TEACHER
PAY
concepts.quote: 41 years ago my wife started teaching in North Carolina's public schools. Today teachers earn less than they did a decade ago.
concepts.highlight: Today teachers earn less than they did a decade ago.
concepts.notes: Autobiographical rather than statistical. Historically a top-performing topic.

headline: OUR
HOSPITALS
concepts.quote: Local hospitals used to be the crown jewels of our communities. Now we stand by while services disappear.
concepts.highlight: Now we stand by while services disappear.
concepts.notes: Sober subject — use the serious frame, not the smile.

headline: THE
JOB
concepts.quote: Records requests take time. That's just part of the job.
concepts.highlight: That's just part of the job.
concepts.notes: Direct follow-on to the Public Records flagship. Same wardrobe family — reads as a series.

headline: RE
BUILDING
concepts.quote: State decisions about funding and rebuilding are what matter now. Planning and recovery is the work I've done for thirty years.
concepts.highlight: Planning and recovery is the work I've done for thirty years.
concepts.notes: The Swain play. Hat earns its place here — content is about being out in the district.

headline: HALF A
DAY
concepts.quote: Four and a half hours to renew your driver's license. That's half a day off work.
concepts.highlight: That's half a day off work.
concepts.source: Shifting Tax Burden.mov @ 43.1s — Mark's own words
concepts.notes: HOLD: confirm the DMV wait time is still current, or cut the number and keep only the second sentence.
